# 📱 Seed starting in the greenhouse

Exported 2026-11-08 09:00 · 4 messages

**You** · 2026-11-07 19:36

When should I start the tomatoes?

**MIA** · 2026-11-07 19:36

About six to eight weeks before your last frost. With the greenhouse heated, mid-February works.

**You** · 2026-11-07 19:39

And peppers?

**MIA** · 2026-11-07 19:39

A couple of weeks earlier than the tomatoes: they're slow to germinate.
